label: Bible Study
prompt: If ye love me, _____ my commandments.
verse: If ye love me, keep my commandments.
note: Said in the Upper Room the night before the cross — love and obedience, linked.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Glory and honour are in his presence; strength and _____ are in his place.
verse: Glory and honour are in his presence; strength and gladness are in his place.
note: Sung the day the ark came to Jerusalem: strength and gladness live wherever God is.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And they came with _____, and found Mary, and Joseph, and the babe lying in a manger.
verse: And they came with haste, and found Mary, and Joseph, and the babe lying in a manger.
note: The shepherds didn't wait till morning — they came with haste and found the baby exactly as the angel said.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Then Moses stood in the gate of the camp, and said, Who is on the LORD'S _____? let him come unto me. And all the sons of Levi gathered themselves together unto him.
verse: Then Moses stood in the gate of the camp, and said, Who is on the LORD'S side? let him come unto me. And all the sons of Levi gathered themselves together unto him.
note: After the golden calf, Moses draws a line in the camp gate — and the tribe of Levi steps over it.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: So when this corruptible shall have put on incorruption, and this mortal shall have put on immortality, then shall be brought to pass the saying that is written, Death is _____ up in victory.
verse: So when this corruptible shall have put on incorruption, and this mortal shall have put on immortality, then shall be brought to pass the saying that is written, Death is swallowed up in victory.
note: Paul quotes Isaiah 25:8 at the resurrection chapter's climax: 'Death is swallowed up in victory.'
